title: Pure Spirit message
summary: Yami Bakura's Spirit Message strategy revolves around assembling the five letters of F-I-N-A-L on the field via the Continuous Trap Destiny Board and the Field Spell Dark Sanctuary to achieve an automatic alternate-win victory! Use Dark Spirit's Mastery to discard a Fiend and search Destiny Board or a Level 8 Fiend (Dark Necrofear, Curse Necrofear, or Dark Spirit of Banishment/Malice). Once Dark Sanctuary is active, all four Spirit Message Spells ('I', 'N', 'A', and 'L') are placed in your Monster Zones as untargetable, attack-immune Fiend monsters instead of clogging your Spell & Trap Zones—while Dark Sanctuary forces your opponent into a 50% coin-toss on every attack that negates the attack and burns them for half their monster's ATK, and Sentence of Doom accelerates placing your Spirit Messages directly from your Deck or GY!

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Level 3 DARK Fiend starter that Special Summons Sangan or Doomdog Octhros from your Deck to link into Muckraker and search Dark Necrofear or Curse Necrofear.
allow.Sangan: Level 3 DARK Fiend summoned by Tour Guide; searches Doomdog Octhros or another Tour Guide when linked off and fuels Dark Necrofear's 3-Fiend GY banish cost.
allow.Doomdog Octhros: Level 3 DARK Fiend summoned by Tour Guide; when sent from the field to the GY, adds any Level 8 Fiend monster (Dark Necrofear, Curse Necrofear, Dark Spirit of Banishment, or Dark Spirit of Malice!) from your Deck to your hand!
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: adds the essential Dark Sanctuary Field Spell directly from your Deck to your hand.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Dark Spirit of Banishment, Dark Spirit of Malice, or Doomdog Octhros to the GY.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 DARK Fiend that links off Tour Guide + Doomdog Octhros/Sangan to trigger their Level 8 Fiend searches and revives Fiends from your GY.
allow.Knightmare Phoenix: Link-2 Fiend that discards a Fiend to destroy a Spell/Trap while loading your GY with Fiends for Dark Necrofear.
allow.Knightmare Unicorn: Link-3 Fiend that spins an opposing card into the Deck and loads Fiends into your GY.

main: Destiny Board

Core Continuous Trap: during each of your opponent's End Phases, places 1 'Spirit Message' card from your hand or Deck in the proper order ('I', 'N', 'A', 'L'); when all 4 Spirit Messages and Destiny Board are on your field, you immediately WIN the Duel!
Spirit Message "I"
First letter of Destiny Board; placed by Destiny Board or Sentence of Doom, and becomes an untargetable Monster Zone body under Dark Sanctuary.
Spirit Message "N"
Second letter of Destiny Board; placed after 'I' via Destiny Board or Sentence of Doom.
Spirit Message "A"
Third letter of Destiny Board; placed after 'N' via Destiny Board or Sentence of Doom.
Spirit Message "L"
Final letter of Destiny Board; completes the F-I-N-A-L win condition!
Dark Sanctuary

Core Field Spell: lets you Special Summon 'Spirit Message' cards placed by Destiny Board as Normal Monsters (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) that are unaffected by card effects and cannot be targeted for attacks; and whenever an opponent's monster attacks, flips a coin—on heads, negates the attack and burns your opponent for half that monster's ATK!
Dark Spirit's Mastery

Core Spell: discards 1 card to add 'Destiny Board' OR any Level 8 Fiend monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, and banishes itself from your GY to shuffle any number of Destiny Board / Spirit Message cards from your hand/GY into the Deck and draw that many cards!
Sentence of Doom

Signature Continuous Trap: adds or recycles Level 8 Fiends from your GY/banishment, OR sends itself from the field to the GY to place 1 'Spirit Message' card directly from your hand, Deck, or GY—completing Destiny Board twice as fast!
Dark Necrofear

Bakura's Level 8 DARK Fiend boss (2200 ATK / 2800 DEF): banishes 3 Fiends from your GY to Special Summon itself, and equips to an opponent's monster during the End Phase if destroyed by your opponent to permanently steal control of it!
Curse Necrofear

Modern Level 8 DARK Fiend boss (2800 ATK): Special Summons itself by shuffling 3 of your banished Fiends into the Deck; if destroyed by your opponent, revives during the End Phase and destroys cards your opponent controls up to the number of different Face-up Spells/Traps (Destiny Board + Spirit Messages!) you control!
Dark Spirit of Banishment

Level 8 DARK Fiend: when an opponent's monster declares an attack, sends itself from your hand or field to the GY to revive Dark Necrofear or Curse Necrofear from your GY and redirect the attack onto it; recovers itself to your hand whenever a Level 8 Fiend goes to your GY!
Dark Spirit of Malice

Level 8 DARK Fiend: when your opponent activates a card or effect, sends itself from your hand or field to the GY to revive a Level 8 Fiend from your GY (negating its effects), and recovers itself whenever a Level 8 Fiend goes to your GY!
Tour Guide From the Underworld
One-card Fiend engine starter that Special Summons Doomdog Octhros or Sangan directly from your Deck.
Doomdog Octhros
Searches Dark Necrofear, Curse Necrofear, Dark Spirit of Banishment, or Dark Spirit of Malice when sent from the field to the GY.
Sangan
Searches Tour Guide or Doomdog Octhros when linked off.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Dark Sanctuary.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Dark Spirit of Banishment or Malice to the GY.
extra: Link-2 DARK Fiend: links off Tour Guide + Doomdog Octhros (triggering Octhros to search a Level 8 Fiend!) and discards a card to revive any Fiend from your GY.
Link-2 Fiend that pops an opponent's Spell/Trap and puts Fiends in your GY for Dark Necrofear.
Link-3 Fiend that shuffles an opposing card into the Deck.
